question: Which pairs of deities must not be worshipped together in one place?
premises: A pair of śaktis is mentioned.
A pair of suns is mentioned likewise.
Worshipping them in one place is prohibited.
inference: One should not worship a pair of śaktis or a pair of suns together in one place.
uncertainties: The specific identities of the two śaktis and two suns are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should not worship a pair of śaktis, nor likewise a pair of suns, in the same place.
